headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,677 INTO JACKSON HOLE — WARSH'S DEBUT ADDRESS FRIDAY, PCE DATA WEDNESDAY AS DEBASEMENT BID INTACT
snippet: Spot gold held near a three-month high of $4,677 on Tuesday as dollar weakness and the Treasury's doubled long-bond buyback program sustained the debasement bid. Markets are bracing for Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first-ever Jackson Hole keynote on Friday and Wednesday's PCE inflation print — a dovish surprise is seen as the next catalyst for gold.

headline: AMERICAN EAGLE DRILLS 411m AT 0.43% CuEq FROM 47m — FIRST 2026 STEP-OUT EXTENDS NAK PORPHYRY EAST IN BRITISH COLUMBIA
snippet: American Eagle Gold (TSXV: AE) hit 411 metres of 0.43% CuEq from 47m in hole NAK26-89 — the first 2026 step-out east of the South Zone — sitting within a broader 880m envelope at 0.30% CuEq. The result extends NAK's already-large porphyry footprint and opens a new corridor yet to be systematically tested.

headline: COPPER HOLDS $14,043 AT LME — ING: 42-SESSION WAREHOUSE DRAWDOWN CREATED STRUCTURAL PRICE FLOOR DESPITE PARTIAL BOUNCE
snippet: ING's commodities team said tight LME copper inventories sustain a price floor above $14,000/t even as on-warrant stocks partially recovered after hitting lows not seen since 2014. LME cancelled warrants rose by a record 51,400 tonnes intraday Tuesday, signalling fresh drawdown orders — and nearly half of remaining stocks are still flagged for delivery.

headline: THREE PATHS TO U.S. RARE EARTH RESILIENCE — ALLIED MINES, TECH TRANSFER, DOMESTIC STOCKPILING: NONE FAST
snippet: A new Metal Tech News analysis published August 25 maps the three viable routes to reducing US rare earth dependence on China: securing production from allied nations (Australia, Canada, Brazil), forcing technology transfer through trade agreements, and building strategic stockpiles — concluding that no single path is sufficient and all face multi-year timelines.

headline: WILL WARSH'S JACKSON HOLE ADDRESS IGNITE GOLD AND SILVER'S NEXT EXPLOSIVE BREAKOUT?
snippet: With Warsh's debut Jackson Hole keynote on Friday, FX Empire analysts argue a dovish surprise would be 'ultra-bullish' for gold as markets would refocus simultaneously on debasement and Fed independence concerns. The only credible bear case is a hawkish pivot that reprices rate cuts out entirely — seen as low-probability given Treasury's concurrent buyback messaging.

headline: US DOUBLES LONG-BOND BUYBACKS TO $4B PER OPERATION — SCMP: DEBASEMENT TRADE REINFORCED AS GOLD BID HOLDS INTO JACKSON HOLE
snippet: Treasury Secretary Bessent's decision to double 10-to-30-year security buybacks to at least $4B per operation has renewed concerns about US fiscal credibility and the purchasing power of the dollar. The South China Morning Post notes gold's 15% monthly gain is tracking its strongest August since 1999, with the debasement trade now a primary institutional driver.

headline: SILVER DOWN 47% FROM $121.62 RECORD — GOLD-SILVER RATIO REVERTS TO 70 AS SPECULATIVE LONGS HIT 60-WEEK LOW
snippet: Silver sits 47% below its January record of $121.62/oz while gold has recovered sharply, pushing the gold-silver ratio back to 70 from the 45 low earlier this year. GoldSilver.com's August outlook highlights speculative positioning at the 20th percentile of 60 weeks — historically a setup for sharp reversals — but flags the 50-day EMA downtrend as still unbroken.

headline: BULLION GOLD COMPLETES 3,909m TERRAGOLD VALIDATION PROGRAM — 32 HOLES PAVE WAY FOR MAIDEN RESOURCE NEAR SENNETERRE, QUEBEC
snippet: Bullion Gold Discoveries (TSXV: BGD) wrapped up its systematic 3,909m, 32-hole validation drilling program at the Terragold property 12km south of Senneterre, Quebec, confirming historical mineralization. The company will compile results and move toward an initial resource estimate, adding to the active Quebec gold exploration scene.

headline: GOLD'S 15% AUGUST MONTHLY GAIN EXPLAINED — TREASURY DEBASEMENT TRADE, DOLLAR SLIDE, AND THE ONE CATALYST THAT COULD REVERSE IT
snippet: Canadian Mining Report breaks down what's behind gold's strongest August performance since 1999: the Treasury's bond buyback program reigniting debasement concerns, a weakening US dollar, and strategic accumulation ahead of Jackson Hole. The analysis identifies three risks to the rally — a hawkish Warsh speech, a hot PCE print, and a reversal in central bank buying — while leaning constructive through Q3.

headline: BUNKER HILL AND SILVER47 MERGE TO CREATE 'MADE IN AMERICA' U.S. SILVER CHAMPION — 38% PREMIUM OFFERED TO AGA SHAREHOLDERS
snippet: Bunker Hill Mining (TSX: BNKR) agreed to acquire Silver47 Exploration (TSXV: AGA) in a share-exchange deal valuing AGA at a 38% premium, creating a combined 'Bunker Hill Silver Corp.' that pairs the operational Bunker Hill Mine in Idaho's Silver Valley with Silver47's U.S. exploration pipeline in Alaska, Nevada, and New Mexico. The deal was announced August 21 and targets critical minerals supply-chain positioning.
